hero.title: Luxurious Accommodations
hero.subtitle: Discover comfort and elegance in our thoughtfully designed rooms and suites

intro.title: Find Your Perfect Stay
intro.content: At Eastin Hotel Madhapur, we offer a variety of room and suite options to cater to your specific needs. Each accommodation is thoughtfully designed with premium furnishings, modern amenities, and sophisticated décor to ensure a memorable stay. Whether you're traveling for business or leisure, our rooms provide the perfect balance of comfort, functionality, and luxury.

rooms.name: Superior Twin Room
rooms.shortDescription: Elegant and comfortable room featuring two twin beds, perfect for friends or colleagues.

rooms.name: Superior King Room
rooms.shortDescription: Spacious room with a luxurious king-sized bed, ideal for couples or solo travelers seeking extra comfort.

rooms.name: Premium Room
rooms.shortDescription: Enhanced room offering additional space and upgraded amenities for a truly comfortable stay.

rooms.name: Premium Twin Room
rooms.shortDescription: Luxurious twin room with premium amenities and extra space, perfect for families or sharing.

rooms.name: Junior Suite King
rooms.shortDescription: Sophisticated suite featuring a bedroom and small sitting area, offering additional space to relax.

rooms.name: Executive Suite
rooms.shortDescription: Luxurious suite with separate bedroom and living room, perfect for extended stays or those seeking ultimate comfort.

items.title: Children Policy
items.content: Children under 12 years stay free when using existing bedding. Cribs available upon request.

items.title: Pet Policy
items.content: We regret that pets are not allowed, with the exception of service animals.

items.title: Smoking Policy
items.content: All rooms and suites are non-smoking. Designated smoking areas are available.

cta.title: Ready to Experience Luxury?
cta.content: Book directly with us for the best rates and exclusive benefits
